data.description:
## Overview
Add CLI subcommands for causal analysis to the GoT CLI.

## File References
- CLI entry point: scripts/got_utils.py
- CLI modules: cortical/got/cli/ (add causal.py)
- Existing CLI patterns: cortical/got/cli/task.py, cortical/got/cli/analyze.py

## Commands to Implement
```bash
got causal chain <task_id>      # Trace dependency chain to root cause
got causal impact <task_id>     # Show downstream impact of delays
got causal blockers             # List all blocking chains sorted by impact
got causal sprint <sprint_id>   # Sprint retrospective causal analysis
got causal necessity <cause> <effect>  # Calculate causal necessity
got causal health               # Data quality assessment for causal analysis
```

## Implementation Notes
- Follow existing CLI patterns (click decorators)
- Output should be human-readable with optional --json flag
- Include data quality warnings when analysis is unreliable

## Acceptance Criteria
- All commands execute without error
- Output is clear and actionable
- --help provides usage examples
data.title: Add causal CLI commands to got_utils.py
